title: AuthStatus

authMethod.description: How the account signed in, in the provider's words; null when signed out.

subscriptionType.description: The plan the login is on, in the provider's words.

error.description: Why the status could not be read, when it could not.

expired.description: True when the provider says the login has lapsed and must be signed in again; absent when it cannot tell. Claude's status command cannot, so its adapter says so only once the refresh of an expired login has failed.

description: An account's sign-in state: signed in or not, how, as whom, on which plan, or why it could not be read.
